notes: Bay Area Reporter, 6 January 1994 to 28 December 1995, 104 weekly issues (with one 1992 notice that a 1994 advertisement gives a number to), read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 1996 to 2005 remain: 500 issues in the collection, January 1996 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 16,534 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 772 windows after the advertisement filter (399 of them rescued for an event word) in 677 address clusters, of which 306 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 84, all read; plus 902 event-word passages, of which the 19 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 28 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 23 resolved and published on 22 pages, 1 of them seeded: 4035 18th Street (with its 3 unit pages), which takes up the community center's 1993 opening held since the 1992-1993 batch. 3 held (518 Waller, 416 Precita, 1546 Market). 2 unresolved (4 Valencia, 425 Castro). Not entered: the arson fire that destroyed St. Paulus Lutheran Church on 5 November 1995, for which the paper prints no address.
